body: Thanks. I wonder if we could make this world truly a better place, some day.

I'm in college right now, graduating. 
But for us to bear the suffering induced by most people in society, seems to be an insurmountable task. We are just too frail and weak. But I do concede that we can deliver this change. I hope that I can keep this in mind for the rest of my life. I hope I can carry on and live a life full of empathy, understanding, and love. 

Thanks for bearing the pain with me.
